[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43002390/ea7c1b91e48fc75d25fb64c1c6e7aa8e068e63af.png[/img]
[h1]0.9 Update[/h1]
[list]
[*]Stricter Rating System: This Makes Even More Necessary to Plan out a Strategy ;Sometimes It Is Strategically Effective to Upgrade Unnecessary Cards and Buy Unnecessary Items / There Are Many Opportunities to Lose Strong Cards, so It's No Longer Easy to Maintain a Strong Deck / Instead, Enemies Are Set to Not Be Too Strong Overall, so Luck is Less Needed
[/list]
[list]
[*]Instant Death Attack: Not Only Does the Enemies' Attack Powers increase if Battles Drags On, but the Enemies Also Fire Instant Death Attacks, Completely Preventint Battles from Never Ending and Taking Too Long (At Other Times, There Is Only One New Monster That Will Perform an Instant Death Attack, and I Have Carefully Calculated and Introduced it by Setting Its HP Extremely Low, Naturally, It Is Necessary to Defeat It Before Performing an Instant Death Attack, Players Who Focus on Poison Attacks Will Need Strategies Such as Preparing Items and Avoiding the Battles with It)
[/list]
[list]
[*]Added Monster <Dholes: Instant Death Attack, Paralysis, Bleeding>, Total 45 Excluding Bosses
[/list]
